records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Net sales for the third quarter of fiscal year 2021 increased $111.1 million, or 30 percent, to $485.8 million from $374.7 million in the third quarter of fiscal year 2020.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: To date, any negative impact of COVID-19 on the overall demand for our products, cash flow from operations, need for capital expenditures, and our liquidity position has been limited.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: In August 2018, the FASB issued ASU No. 2018-15, Intangibles - Goodwill and Other - Internal-Use Software (Subtopic 350-40), Customer’s Accounting for Implementation Costs Incurred in a Cloud Computing Arrangement That Is a Service Contract.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Gross margin was 51.8 percent in the third quarter of fiscal year 2021, down from 52.7 percent in the third quarter of fiscal year 2020.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Cash flow from operations was $176.4 million for the first nine months of fiscal year 2021 versus $246.5 million for the corresponding period of fiscal year 2020.
